summary: A little-documented fire tower in Beauregard Parish, Louisiana, recorded only as still standing near the community of Fields.

access.note: Visible from a public road on Google Street View; no record of public climbing access.

evidence.supports: visible from the road, not a visited structure
evidence.quote: Tower is visible here on Google Street View.

sources.title: List of fire lookout towers in Louisiana

notes_for_editor: Very thin sourcing. No entry for Fields Fire Tower in the cached NHLR or FFLOS (firetower.org) Louisiana registers, and no mention in the cached centraluslookouts.com Louisiana page beyond a bare county-header photo callout with no text. Wikipedia's own citation for 'still standing' points to a USGS GNIS feature-detail page (geonames.usgs.gov, Apex app); it is JavaScript-rendered and returned only the generic USGS/Board on Geographic Names homepage when fetched, so it could not be used directly. One WebSearch and two page reads were spent (this Wikipedia page plus the dead-end GNIS fetch); stopped researching rather than spend more of the budget chasing a page that would not render. Builder, construction date, design, height, and managing agency are all unknown and should not be guessed. A human with access to LDAF's Louisiana Statewide Forest Resource Assessment and Strategy PDF (cited elsewhere in the same Wikipedia list, pp. 36-37) might find more.
